name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-cloudinary
description: ImageAdapter (@mercatus-liber/media, image-cdn epic) backed by Cloudinary's real, documented "fetch" delivery type: https://res.cloudinary.com/<cloud_name>/image/fetch/<transformations>/<remote_url> -- Cloudinary fetches the remote image, applies the transformation, caches it on its CDN, and serves it back, without the source ever being uploaded into a Cloudinary media library. Confirmed against Cloudinary's own current documentation (cloudinary.com/documentation/fetch_remote_images). Needs only a Cloudinary cloud name (no API key/secret -- fetch mode's default, unsigned form), so this works against any free Cloudinary account. Public surface is exactly ImageAdapter; depends on @mercatus-liber/media for the interface it implements. No HTTP calls of its own -- resolveUrl is pure string construction (see ImageAdapter's own doc comment for why).
